channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Young people inspire £85,000–£100,000 Castleton pump track proposal
item.description: A site beside the yellow play park on Manchester Road is being explored for a Castleton bike track, with young people helping shape the idea. Funding and approvals remain outstanding.

item.title: Rochdale Council Moves Forward with Hopwood Hall Redevelopment After High Court Ruling
item.description: Following a High Court ruling, Rochdale Council has confirmed plans to redevelop Hopwood Hall, with an emphasis on community use, after ending an exclusivity agreement with Hopwood DePree.

item.title: 65 Rochdale food businesses currently rated 0 or 1 for hygiene
item.description: 65 food businesses in the Rochdale borough currently hold a food hygiene rating of 0 or 1, according to Food Standards Agency records checked on 16 October 2026. Seven are rated 0, where urgent improvement is necessary; 58 are rated 1, where major improvement is necessary.

item.title: The Healey Dell prophecy: the Lady Eleanor who was said to be 'maid, wife and widow in one day'
item.description: A short guide to the strange Healey Dell story about Eleanor Byron and a fortune‑teller called Mother Bagden — what the old printed collectors actually recorded, what local guides now tell visitors, and what survives as verifiable fact.

item.title: Rochdale Council Celebrates Achievements of Over 200 Cared-for Children at Annual Awards
item.description: Rochdale Council hosted its annual awards ceremony at Matthew Moss High School, recognising the achievements of more than 200 cared-for children with medals and a day of entertainment.

item.title: St Cuthbert’s RC High School Closes Following Bomb Threat
item.description: St Cuthbert’s RC High School in Rochdale was evacuated and closed on 16 October after receiving a suspected bomb threat. All students and staff were reported safe, and police are investigating the incident.

item.title: Rochdale AFC to Face Crewe Alexandra in Away Fixture
item.description: Rochdale AFC will play against Crewe Alexandra in an away match this weekend, seeking vital points in their league campaign.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Confirms FA Cup First Round Draw on October 16
item.description: Rochdale AFC has confirmed the FA Cup first round draw will take place on October 16 at 7:00 PM, with live updates available on their official website.

item.title: St Cuthbert’s evacuated as message reassures parents all children and staff are safe
item.description: St Teresa of Calcutta Catholic Academy Trust says St Cuthbert’s was evacuated following a possible bomb threat. All children and staff are safe; parents can collect pupils.

item.title: Rochdale Council Plans Major Investments and Heritage Restoration
item.description: Rochdale Council has announced significant investments in heritage restoration and community services, including plans for Hopwood Hall and Middleton's regeneration projects, aimed at boosting local economy and services.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Friday 16 October 2026
item.description: 14 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: High Court Trial Begins Over Ownership of Hopwood Hall
item.description: A two-day trial in Manchester's High Court will determine the future of Hopwood Hall, as Hopwood DePree seeks to reclaim his ancestral home from Rochdale Council.

item.title: Rochdale Fitness Group to Undertake 100km Arctic Challenge for Cancer Charities
item.description: Eighteen runners from Resilience gym in Rochdale will embark on a 100km run across the Arctic wilderness on January 29, 2027, to raise funds for cancer charities.

item.title: Jolly Josh welcomes Rochdale families with inclusive play, music and activity sessions
item.description: The Castleton charity is reaching out to families caring for children and young people with complex medical needs and physical disabilities, with weekly sessions and bookable activities.

item.title: Fireworks distributor with Rochdale premises fined £40,000 as fire service takes enforcement action
item.description: GMFRS has announced prosecutions over fireworks storage and licensing breaches, including a £40,000 fine for Boom Fireworks, which operates premises in Rochdale.

item.title: Veterans group calls on Rochdale volunteers to help transform Sea Cadets’ outdoor space
item.description: Get Together After Serving, now based at Denehurst Café, is appealing for volunteers, tools and a donated skip to support Rochdale Sea Cadets.

item.title: Safeguarding concerns, community costs and fireworks raised at Rochdale council meeting
item.description: Farooq Ahmed raised concerns about safeguarding powers, while Jordan Tarrant-Short questioned venue costs, fireworks, foster care and Warwick Mill at full council.

item.title: Future of College Bank Towers Uncertain as Renovation Could Take Over a Decade
item.description: Housing chiefs have stated that renovating the College Bank tower blocks would displace residents for more than ten years, with no decision yet made on their future.

item.title: Heywood and Middleton North MP Visits Redwood School’s Sixth Form at Phoenix Centre
item.description: Elsie Blundell, MP for Heywood and Middleton North, visited Redwood School’s sixth form at the Phoenix Centre to engage with students and staff about their educational initiatives.

item.title: Pure 80's Festival 2027
item.description: Pure 80's music festival is back for a third year!!! Rochdale's biggest celebration of everything 80's featuring some of the countries top tribute acts! Littleborough, Denhurst Rd, Littleborough OL15 9LD, UK

item.title: Springhill Hospice to Host Free Will Information Clinic in Heywood
item.description: Springhill Hospice is offering a free information clinic for those looking to make or update their wills, with expert guidance available.

item.title: Plans for 45-Home Development in Bamford Face Over 300 Objections
item.description: More than 300 objections have been lodged against plans to demolish a house in Bamford to make way for a new 45-home development, which is recommended for approval by Rochdale Council.

item.title: Volunteers and council team tackle overgrown areas at Middleton’s Jubilee Park
item.description: The Friends of Jubilee Park and council staff have joined forces for the second phase of work to manage overgrown shrubs and care for the park’s rhododendrons.

item.title: Inclusive roundabout and zip line feature in plans for new Falinge Park play area
item.description: Mayoress Iram Faisal has unveiled plans for new play equipment at Falinge Park, including a wheelchair-accessible roundabout, an inclusive seesaw and a double cableway zip line.

item.title: Emmerdale star Lisa Riley meets shoppers as Peacocks opens in Rochdale
item.description: Peacocks opened its new Rochdale Riverside store on Thursday, with Emmerdale star Lisa Riley joining the celebrations and posing for photographs with shoppers.

item.title: Rochdale’s Owen Webster ready for fresh start in BKFC featherweight clash
item.description: Rochdale-born Owen Webster says he is ready to “take over the game” ahead of his featherweight bout against Dan Morel at Glasgow’s OVO Hydro on 7 November.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Manager Urges Team to Embrace Fearless Mentality
item.description: Rochdale AFC's manager, Watson, has called on his players to adopt a fearless approach as they prepare for their next fixtures, emphasising confidence and resilience.

item.title: Rochdale social worker Nneamaka Uti shortlisted for national award
item.description: Nneamaka Uti, who works in Rochdale Council’s adult care service, is a finalist in the Social Worker of the Year Awards, with winners announced on 22 October.

item.title: Rochdale Council Announces Free Bonfire Night Events for November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Council will host three free firework displays across the borough in early November, featuring reduced noise fireworks for accessibility.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Announces Community Tour of Bowlee
item.description: Rochdale AFC has announced a community tour of Bowlee, inviting fans to explore the area significant to the club's heritage. Details on the date and itinerary will be released soon.

item.title: Rochdale's Sustainable Materials & Manufacturing Centre Set to Drive Advanced Manufacturing
item.description: The Sustainable Materials & Manufacturing Centre at Kingsway Business Park marks a significant step for Rochdale's advanced manufacturing sector, with operations expected to commence in 2027.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Co-Chair Addresses State of the Game Report
item.description: Rochdale AFC's co-chair has discussed the recent State of the Game report, outlining key challenges and future directions for the club and the sport.

item.title: Ofsted Inspection Report Published for Little Wonders Nursery in Rochdale
item.description: Ofsted has released a new inspection report for Little Wonders Nursery, detailing its findings and the rating awarded following the recent assessment.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Thursday 15 October 2026
item.description: 7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Did Robin Hood really come to Healey Dell?
item.description: Local stories tie a lost ring, witches and a 'Fairy Chapel' to Robin Hood — the tales are colourful, but what do the records actually show?

item.title: Cozy Market in Milnrow Shut Down Again for Selling Illicit Tobacco
item.description: Rochdale Trading Standards has secured a three-month closure order for Cozy Market on Dale Street, Milnrow, following repeated violations involving the sale of illegal tobacco products.

item.title: Nantwich Town Women Defeat Rochdale Women 3-1 in WFA Cup
item.description: Nantwich Town Women secured a place in the next round of the WFA Cup with a 3-1 victory over Rochdale AFC at the Crown Oil Arena on October 15.

item.title: Halloween in Rochdale 2026: parties, pumpkins and spooky events across the borough
item.description: 39 dated Halloween listings across Rochdale, Heywood, Middleton, Milnrow, Littleborough, Norden and Wardle, with prices, times, age suitability, venues and booking links.

item.title: East Middleton councillor questions parking charge warning after petrol station breakdown
item.description: Labour councillor Georgina Jacques says she was warned about a parking charge while waiting for the RAC after her car broke down on Oldham Road.

item.title: Seventeen Arrested in Police Operation Targeting Organised Crime in Rochdale and Heywood
item.description: A police operation has led to the arrest of seventeen individuals as officers tackle an organised crime group linked to violent incidents earlier this year.

item.title: Teenager Jailed for Fatal Crash in Middleton After Teaching Himself to Drive
item.description: An 18-year-old has been sentenced to nearly seven years in prison after causing the death of a grandfather in Middleton while driving unlicensed and recklessly.

item.title: A kitchen to be proud of this Christmas: meet Rochdale’s family-run SJF Granite & Quartz
item.description: With 25 years of experience and a reported 124 five-star reviews, this local family business puts craftsmanship and personal service at the heart of its work.

item.title: Pacific, Mangos and Empire until morning: remembering Rochdale’s strip
item.description: Box-dye red hair, Jägerbombs and taxi queues that lasted hours—remembering Rochdale’s strip, its familiar faces and the venues keeping the town alive today.

item.title: QTS Group Hosts First Safety Jamboree in Rochdale with Over 350 Attendees
item.description: The QTS Group's inaugural safety Jamboree at Ashworth Valley Scout Camp in Rochdale attracted more than 350 participants, focusing on health, safety, and innovation in the rail industry.

item.title: Rochdale Council Announces New Regeneration Projects for Middleton
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has unveiled a series of regeneration projects aimed at revitalising Middleton, including the restoration of Hopwood Hall and the acquisition of Warwick Mill.

item.title: Temporary Closure of Hillcrest Road in Rochdale for Roadworks from 26 October 2026
item.description: Temporary closure of Hillcrest Road will take place from 26 October to 30 October 2026, affecting local traffic and access.

item.title: Bamford and Norden’s 450-home allocation: housing choice versus pressure on green space
item.description: The Bamford and Norden allocation envisages around 450 homes alongside improvements to sports and recreation facilities. Its development framework promotes family and affordable housing, but a framework does not establish a completed scheme, a housebuilder’s final layout or an affordable tenancy.

item.title: College Bank’s future remains a housing question as residents move from the Seven Sisters
item.description: College Bank’s future cannot yet be presented as a confirmed number of new homes. RBH’s July 2026 update records that 100 customers had accepted offers of another home and 64 had moved from the high-rise blocks at that point.

item.title: Crimble Mill’s housing plans must balance heritage rescue with the cost to local families
item.description: Crimble Mill’s detailed scheme is 214 homes: 33 apartments in the mill, 31 houses in the existing complex and 150 houses on neighbouring greenfield land. The broader 250-home allocation is not a second development or the approved detailed count.

item.title: Foundry Fields approval includes only five reported social-rent homes among 199 houses
item.description: Taylor Wimpey’s Foundry Fields scheme received a reported six-to-four committee vote in favour, with one abstention, in January 2026. The 199-home proposal includes detached, semi-detached and terraced houses, with five reported social-rented properties.
